verdict.rationale: Gazebo installs and runs entirely on the user's own machines. Ubuntu packages are documented, including a lightweight gz-sim-server package with no GUI or Qt dependencies. The simulator can run headless with `-s`, the GUI can attach separately to a server instance, and simulations can run on remote servers through Gazebo Transport, with the code hosted publicly on GitHub. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the open-source license and build-from-source instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
